title: User management
deleteConfirm: Remove {{email}}'s CarLog data and their access to CarLog? Their Only Tools account stays.
aiProviderHint: Where chat, invoice scanning and text import send their requests.
aiProviderNote_anthropic: Calls Anthropic directly with the API key below, billed to that key's Claude Console account.
aiProviderNote_bedrock: Runs in CarLog's AWS account and is billed by AWS. No key needed.
aiModelHint: The same model serves chat and document reading.
aiModelNote_claude-haiku-5-5: Newer and cheaper. On Bedrock it needs AWS quota for this account, so run Test before saving.
aiKeyHint: Used only when the Claude API is selected. It's stored encrypted and never shown again.
aiKeyWhere: Create one at platform.claude.com → API keys.
aiKeyWillBeRemoved: The key will be removed when you save.
aiKeyError_SUBSCRIPTION_TOKEN: That's a Claude Pro/Max subscription token, which can't run an app for other people. Create an API key at platform.claude.com instead.
aiKeyError_INVALID_API_KEY: This doesn't look like a Claude API key (they start with sk-ant-api).
aiNeedsKey: Add a Claude API key to use the Claude API.
aiTestOk: Connected. The model answered in {{ms}} ms.
aiTestError_NO_KEY: Add a Claude API key first.
aiTestError_FORBIDDEN: This account isn't allowed to use that model.
aiTestError_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: That model isn't available on this provider.
aiTestError_RATE_LIMITED: Rate limited. Try again in a minute.
aiSaved: Saved. All users get the change within a minute.
aiAppliesTo: Applies to every user. Last changed {{date}}.
aiAppliesToDefault: Applies to every user. Not changed yet: CarLog is using the default.
